description: This Java class implements RFC 8259 for escaping individual characters in JSON strings, including handling of control characters, escape sequences, and Unicode characters.

classes.name: JsonCharEscaper
classes.description: A final class implementing character escaping for JSON strings, following RFC 8259, with additional handling for line and paragraph separator characters.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of JsonCharEscaper.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Escapes a given character if necessary, returning the escape sequence or null if no escaping is needed.
